# Context before checking

This is informed new source authored by the Codex reviewer after reading the
current #43 implementation contract, source type/projection and lowering code,
existing finite split/join and coherent-lift code, and native structural rules.
It is not a blind authoring benchmark. No external model was invoked; exact
deployed model and sampling settings were not recorded. The previous Unit-map
study and real failures are known. Current Q<Tuple> projection rejects and
selected split/join are not yet catalogued; finite unit/finish are absent.

All 22 complete projects, independent intended equations, context and exact
Issue contract are saved and hashed before any CLI call or production edit.
No source is repaired in place. Deliberate counterexamples are labeled, not
repair attempts; grouped declarations may be masked by their first failure.
All programs use at most two physical system qubits. Reference laws are target
properties for later independent tests, not executed by this diagnostic study.
Each finite project has an empty main: checking does not execute its open f.

The existing Unit-map CLI is reused; no Rust/Lean build, new native acceptance
logic or external source download occurs. The current branch commit is recorded
separately from the binary hash and its historical build inputs. Constitution
continuity source-only check against supplied 9a1ecef passed; QS/PR/RS and EXACT,
the two admitted QLV1 structural guarantees and all pending duties are unchanged.
This study is ordinary implementation preparation and creates no adoption.
